End coord basis: OSM Nominatim town-center node for Borg El Arab. DUPLICATE CHECK (per brief): this repo's own country notes record a prior adjudication that the Sadat City-Dahshur ~75 km line is 'a second, later Kureimat supply, not a competing identity' relative to the Zaafarana-Kureimat (P8014) line documented in a World Bank ICR -- i.e. already resolved as distinct, not a duplicate; I am not citing that internal note as an output source, only using it to confirm I'm not re-litigating a settled question. Independently searched Arabic-language sources for a second corroborating source beyond youm7 (per rule 4): found a Ministry of Petroleum project-approval notice (almasdar.com/164809) that names 'the existing Sadat/Dahshour 42-inch gas line' verbatim while approving an unrelated connecting project -- a genuinely independent government-notice source, though it only corroborates existence + diameter, not the 74 km length or exact 2013 date/cost (those remain single-sourced to youm7). Also checked a petro-news.com roundup of ~39 GASCO-era gas projects; it lists several other Dahshour-adjacent lines (Dahshour-El Wasta 65km/36in, New Capital-Dahshour 'Siemens' 70km/32in, Noubareya-Sadat 70km/36in) but none matching this exact Sadat-Dahshour identity, which is consistent with this being an older (2013) line predating that roundup's newer-project list rather than evidence against it. Sadat City start point is a city-level (not station-level) anchor since no named in-city GASCO facility could be found; Dahshour end reuses P8032's EIB-sourced valve-room coordinate on the reasoning that both lines converge on the same documented hub -- flagging this reuse candidly since it is an inference (same named hub, not a second independently-surveyed coordinate for this specific line's own tie-in point). Recommend RouteAccuracy no better than 'low'.  Start coord basis: OSM Nominatim city-center node (place=city) for Sadat City. I searched specifically for a named GASCO measurement/take-off station within Sadat City and found none in any accessible source, so this is a reduced-accuracy, city-level anchor per the brief's allowance -- the sheet's own StartLocation is 'Sadat' with no more specific facility, and the cited 2013 youm7 article and a Ministry of Petroleum project notice both describe the line simply as the 'Sadat/Dahshour' line without naming an in-city station..  End coord basis: Same EIB/PETROSAFE-documented Dahshour valve-room point used for P8032's Dahshour end (long 31 deg05'49" E, lat 29 deg53'24" N) -- reused here because P8039 is documented as tying into the same Dahshour gas hub/compressor-station area as the Amriya-Dahshour trunk (P8032), and because this repo's own country notes record that a prior adjudication already treats the Sadat City-Dahshur 74/75 km line as a real, separate, later addition supplying Kureimat, not a duplicate of the Zaafarana-Kureimat line -- so the Dahshour-hub identity, not the specific endpoint coordinate, is what that prior adjudication settled; the coordinate itself still comes from the EIB EIA, an independent primary source..
